blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks fell below the 5,800 level on Monday as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran pushed global oil prices higher. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) declined by 0.64 percent, or 37.10 points, to close at 5,788.87.
